notes.title: Demo version update (1.0.40)
notes.notes:
Demo Version 1.0.40:

 * Changed so dying from lasers will reset timer
 * Updated visuals on player trail and goal
 * Fixed issues with gamepad rumble getting stuck

notes.title: Demo version update
notes.notes:
Version: Demo 1.03 Changes:

* Fixed way faster reset time ('F' key)
* Fixed a new hotkey 'Z' or select/back for gamepad, which toggles a level to repeat whenever entering the goal (to easier chase a leaderboard time).
* Fixed some stability and crashes
